objective: The coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-26 after BUILT-BINDING-20261126-001's referee: take a start in which several second-layer knots exist (groups of rings, each group's facts bound by a parity rule) and share whole-held facts the way first-layer knots share distinctions; ask whether, after ordinary growth, a fact exists that no single ring and no single second-layer knot reads (a third-layer fact) under the layer's own small changes, and whether such facts are again bound. Advisor attack with a built candidate and controls before freezing; the smallest such start. status: Complete 2026-11-26 (referee pending): growth sorts facts into two kinds, the families' facts that last and the rest bounded (no failure on 2,349 starts); on a connected start the families' facts obey exactly one relation (proved), so ordinary growth keeps one second-layer knot per connected start and the binding step does not repeat.
title: Does the binding step repeat? A third layer of whole-held facts
